atAGlance: Tôm nướng muối ớt is salt-chili grilled shrimp, usually with smoky shells, chili-salt rub, lime, herbs, and a dipping salt.
whatItIs: Tôm nướng muối ớt is shrimp grilled with chili salt, garlic or lemongrass, and smoke. It is a shell-on, peel-and-dip seafood order more than a rice-paper dish.
howToEnjoy: Peel if needed, squeeze lime, and dip lightly in salt so the grilled shrimp sweetness stays clear. Ask for less chili before the shrimp hits the grill.
howLocalsOrder: Order tôm nướng muối ớt as a shared grilled shrimp plate. Ask whether shells remain and say ít cay before the chili-salt rub goes on.
worthKnowing: Salt-chili grilling is common at seafood shops because the crust gives smoky heat without drowning the shrimp.
goodToKnow: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
travelerCaution: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
